verdict.label: Moderate
verdict.oneLiner: Working in 30 minutes, but restricted Gmail scopes need verification plus a paid annual CASA assessment.
verdict.s2Limit: 100 test users; test-user authorizations expire after 7 days

steps.title: Create a Cloud project
steps.detail: Create a project and enable the Gmail API.

steps.title: Choose the narrowest Gmail scopes
steps.detail: Prefer non-restricted scopes. Restricted scopes trigger the CASA path.
steps.agentAction: Compare scopes against the features and flag restricted ones.

steps.title: Configure the consent screen
steps.detail: Set app name, support email, authorized domain.

steps.title: Create the OAuth client and add test users
steps.detail: Create a Web client, register redirect URIs, add your account as a test user, run the flow.

steps.title: Invite up to 100 test users
steps.detail: Expect re-consent every 7 days while the app is in Testing.

steps.title: Draft privacy policy, scope justifications and demo script
steps.agentAction: Draft the policy text, per-scope justifications and a video script.

steps.title: Verify domain and submit for verification
steps.detail: Verify the domain in Search Console and submit the app.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification review
steps.detail: Reported realistic timeline for restricted scopes.

steps.title: Complete the CASA assessment with an assessor
steps.detail: Engage an authorised assessor, remediate findings, obtain the letter of assessment. Repeats annually.

blockers.cause: The app is in Testing and the signed-in user is not on the test-user list.
blockers.fix: Add the user under Audience > Test users, or publish the app.

blockers.cause: A test-user refresh token is older than 7 days.
blockers.fix: Ask the user to consent again, or move to production.

blockers.cause: A Workspace admin blocked the app for their domain.
blockers.fix: Ask the customer admin to allow the client ID.
